description: List published iGaming event summaries with slugs, canonical URLs, dates, venue and exhibitor counts. Filter by period, region and text together. Defaults to upcoming (including ongoing), page 1, 10 records; upcoming/all sort by start date ascending, past descending. Returns page, total_items, total_pages and items. Use get_event for one event and organiser sources, or list_exhibitors for booths.

limit.description: Records per page, from 1 to 20 (default 10). Use page to continue; total_items and total_pages describe all matches.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1, maximum 500). Keep filters and limit unchanged while paging; stop at total_pages. A page beyond the results returns an empty items array.

period.description: upcoming (default): end_date on or after today in UTC, including ongoing events. past: end_date before today in UTC. all: no date filter.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring in the event title or city, up to 200 characters. Omit or leave empty for all matching events; use search for semantic discovery.

region.description: Match the event region exactly. Omit for all regions; combines with period and query.

name: list_events
title: List events
